title: Adding or modifying web options requires backend, frontend state, and menu updates
answers: How to add a new option to mitmweb?
Where to expose a new configuration option in the mitmweb UI?
What files must change when adding a web setting like web_theme?
Why is a newly added mitmweb option missing from the options menu?
body:
Adding or modifying a user-configurable mitmweb option requires coordinated changes across backend registration, frontend state typing, and the options menu:
1. Register the option with type, default, and valid choices in mitmproxy/tools/web/webaddons.py:WebAddon.load.
2. Add the field and default value to web/src/js/ducks/_options_gen.ts:OptionsState and web/src/js/ducks/_options_gen.ts:defaultState.
3. Expose the configuration control in web/src/js/components/Header/OptionMenu.tsx:OptionMenu (wrapped in HideInStatic for non-static contexts).
4. Validate option registration, default value, and choices in test/mitmproxy/tools/web/test_webaddons.py:test_web_theme_option.
applies: Adding or modifying options in mitmweb
says: The new configuration setting is not showing up in the web options menu.
Add a toggle switch in the options menu to customize web interface preferences.
New web interface option does not appear anywhere in the settings dropdown menu.
User preferences changed in the options menu are missing newly created settings.
